spans.s:
ऐकध्य ऐकध्य, अम्, n. (fr. एकधा), single-
ness of time or occurrence; (अम् or अतस्), ind. at
once, together.

ऐकपत्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-पति), the sovereignty
of one, absolute monarchy; supreme authority.

ऐकपदिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एक-पद), belonging
to a simple word; consisting of single words; the N.
[]
given to the Naigama section of Yāska's commentary
on the Nighaṇṭavas, or collection of Vedic words.
ऐकपद्य, अम्, n. unity of words.

ऐकभाव्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-भाव), singleness
of nature.

ऐकमत्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-मति), unanimity,
sameness of doctrine or of opinion, agreement, con-
sent, concurrence, confederation; (अस्, ई, अम्), con-
nected with sameness of opinion.
ऐकराज्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-राज्), monarchy.
ऐकलव्य, अस्, m. a patronymic fr. एक-लू.

ऐकशतिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एक-शत), provided
with 101.

ऐकशफ, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एक-शफ), produced
by or belonging to animals with uncloven hoofs.

ऐकश्रुत्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-श्रुति, q. v.), the one
accentless monotonous tone, monotony.

ऐकसहस्रिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एक-सहस्र), pro-
vided with 1001.

ऐकस्वर्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-स्वर), oneness of
accent (as in the case of a compound which has only
one accent, though the separate members when un-
compounded are each accented).

ऐकागारिक, अस्, ई, m. f. (fr. एक-आगार), a thief, a
robber breaking into lonely houses; the possessor of
one residence.

ऐकाग्र्य, अम्, n. (fr. एकाग्र), intentness on one
object.

ऐकाङ्ग, अस्, m. (fr. एकाङ्ग), a soldier of the
body-guard.

ऐकात्म्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-आत्मन्), unity of the
soul, unity of being; oneness with the supreme spirit.

ऐकादशाक्ष, अस्, m. (fr. एकादश + अक्ष), N.
of a man.

ऐकादशिन, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एकादशिनी), Ved. be-
longing to a collection or association of eleven.

ऐकाधिकरण्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक + अधिकरण),
oneness of relation.

ऐकान्तिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एकान्त), absolute, com-
plete, perfect.

ऐकान्यिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एक + अन्य), one who
commits a single error in reading (who makes one
thing another or otherwise than right).

ऐकार्थ्य, अम्, n. (fr. एकार्थ), oneness of aim
or intention.

ऐकाहिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. एकाह), ephemeral,
quotidian, of one day, of the same day; belonging
to a ceremony which lasts one day, belonging to a
simple oblation.

ऐकगुण्य, अम्, n. (fr. एक-गुण), the value of a
single unit, simple unity (opposed to द्वैगुण्य).
